z-m-39-01.title: Amanani ahlukile angaba nesamba esifanayo?
z-m-39-01.topic: Incazelo yomsebenzi nemisebenzi eyodwa-kwenye: isimo sesamba samanani nosayizi we-codomain
z-m-39-01.goal: Sebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi incazelo yomsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye (izinto ezihlukile zihambisana namanani ahlukile) ayisho lutho mayelana nezamba zamanani, bese uchaza ukuthi ukuthi umsebenzi onesimo esifanayo ukhona yini kuncike ku-codomain.
z-m-39-01.material: Cabanga ngomsebenzi u-f osuka ku-domain u-X={1, 2, 3, 4} uya ku-codomain u-Y={1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7} njengethebula lamanani. Ithebula lisho kuphela u-f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) (akukho fomula). Isimo (가): u-f ungumsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye, okungukuthi, izinto ezihlukile zika-X zihambisana namanani ahlukile. Isimo (나): u-f(1)+f(4)=f(2)+f(3). UMina wathi, “Uma uyodwa-kwenye, wonke amanani amane ahlukile. Khona-ke izamba zamapheya amabili ngeke zilingane njengo-(나).”
z-m-39-01.thinking.0: Ukuthatha isimangalo sisibeke ethebuleni lamanani bese siyahlolwa
z-m-39-01.thinking.1: Ukwakha izibonelo ezihlukile (izibonelo eziphikisayo) ezanelisa izimo
z-m-39-01.thinking.2: Ukuhlulela ngokwesimo ukuthi umsebenzi onjalo ukhona yini uma i-codomain iguquka
z-m-39-01.prereq.0: Incazelo yomsebenzi, i-domain, i-codomain ne-range, nencazelo yomsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye (ingxenye yokuqala yeyunithi yemisebenzi ye-high school common mathematics)
z-m-39-01.prereq.2: (Umcabango wolandelwano lwesikole: u-H2 walo msebenzi ulebula nje yobunzima enikeziwe ekukhiqizeni, futhi sicabanga ukuthi izimfuneko ezingenhla zifundiwe kakade.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isahlulelo sakho sokuqala sesitatimende sikaMina. (Akudingeki ubale okwamanje.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga u-f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) njengezikhala ezine, bese ugcwalisa izinombolo ezine ezihlukile.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ngezinombolo owazigcwalisile, bhala u-f(1)+f(4) no-f(2)+f(3) ngokuhlukile bese uqhathanisa ukuthi bayalingana yini.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. Uma wonke amanani amane ehlukile, izamba zamapheya amabili nazo ziyahluka
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.a: Uthatha “amanani ahlukile” no-“izamba ziyahluka” njengesitatimende esifanayo. Zikhethele amapheya amabili ahlukile ezinombolo bese uqhathanisa izamba.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.b: Kulungile. Umsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye uyakhula njengoba u-x ekhula, ngakho izamba azikwazi ukulingana
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.b: Uthatha umsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye nomsebenzi okhulayo njengofanayo. Cabanga ukuthi kukhona yini imisebenzi eyodwa-kwenye enamanani ehlayo.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.c: Kuphosile. Noma wonke amanani ehlukile, izamba zamapheya amabili ahlukile zingalingana
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.c: Ufunde isimangalo njengo-“njalo” futhi wabaza ukuthi isibonelo sikhona yini. Manje sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola ukuthi isibonelo esinjalo singakhiwa ngempela yini.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.d: Asikwazi ukuhlulela. Ngoba ifomula luka-f ayinikeziwe
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.d: Ucabanga ngomsebenzi njengefomula kuphela. Lapha, ithebula lamanani amane lanele ukuhlola izimo.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.explain: Isimo sokuba ngumsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye sisho kuphela ukuthi amanani amane ahlukile. Ukuthi izamba zamapheya amabili zingalingana yini noma amanani amane ehlukile kumele kuhlolwe ngokuthola isibonelo ngempela. Ake siyihlole esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa ithebula lamanani, yenza imisebenzi emi-2 u-f enelisa kokubili izimo (가) no-(나) futhi onu-f(1) omkhulu kuno-f(2). Imisebenzi emibili kumele isebenzise amasethi ahlukile amanani. (a=f(1), b=f(2), c=f(3), d=f(4); zonke izinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-7)
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokuthola iqembu lezinombolo ezine ezihlukile lapho u-f(1)+f(4) no-f(2)+f(3) belingana.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.1: Beka izinombolo ezine owazithola ukuze u-f(1) abe mkhulu kuno-f(2), bese uhlola futhi ukuthi izamba ezimbili zisalingana.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.2: Thola elinye iqembu lapho izinombolo uqobo zihlukile kulezo ezisetshenzisiwe emsebenzini wokuqala.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Wonke amanani amane angamalungu e-codomain u-Y (izinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-7).
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Wonke amanani kumele abe yizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-7.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Wonke amanani amane ahlukile, ngakho umsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani elifanayo lisetshenzisiwe kabili. Akulona umsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, u-(3, 1, 6, 4) unu-3+4=7=1+6 futhi wonke amanani amane ahlukile. Ngakho isimangalo sikaMina asisebenzi. Futhi, njengoba kukhona isibonelo onu-f(1)>f(2), umsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye awuhambisi kuphela ngokuya emanani amakhulu. (U-(1, 2, 3, 4) unelisa isimo sesamba kodwa uphula u-f(1)>f(2), ngakho awamukelwa kulesi sinyathelo.)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.prompt: Ulwazi olusha: i-domain isala u-X={1, 2, 3, 4} futhi izimo (가) no-(나) zisala zinjalo, kodwa i-codomain u-Y iguqulwe njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi. Khetha zonke ama-codomain lapho umsebenzi u-f onelisa izimo ungenziwa khona. (Akukho simo sika-f(1)>f(2).)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuyi-codomain ngayinye, khetha izinombolo ezine ezihlukile, uzihlukanise ngamapheya amabili, bese ubhala izamba zamapheya amabili eceleni komunye.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.1: Uma i-codomain inezinto ezingaphansi kwezingu-4, qala ngokubala ukuhlola ukuthi umsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye ungenziwa nhlobo yini.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.a: Kubukeka sengathi ucabange ukuthi izinto ezi-5 zanele. Khetha ezine kuzo, uzihlukanise ngamapheya amabili, bese ubhala wena ukuthi kukhona yini icala lapho izamba zilingana.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.b: Ubheke hhayi kuphela inani lezinto kodwa neqiniso lokuthi izinombolo zihlukaniswe ngokulinganayo. Hlola ukuthi uthole amapheya amabili anezamba ezilinganayo.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.c: Uma ubheka isimo sesamba kuqala, kulula ukuphuthelwa ukuthi azikho izinto ezanele. Qala ngokubala ukuthi kudingeka amanani amangaki ukuba ngumsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.d: Uhlolile ukuthi i-codomain enosayizi ofanayo ne-domain nayo inamapheya amabili anezamba ezilinganayo. Ucabange ngecala lapho zonke izinombolo ezine zisetshenziswa.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.explain: U-{1,2,3} unezinto ezi-3 kuphela, ngakho izinto ezine zika-X azikwazi ukuba namanani ahlukile, futhi akukho msebenzi oyodwa-kwenye nhlobo. U-{1,2,3,4} unu-1+4=2+3, no-{2,5,8,11,14} unamapheya amabili anezamba ezilinganayo njengo-2+14=5+11. U-{1,2,4,8,16} unezinto ezi-5, kodwa akukho icala lapho izamba zamapheya amabili ahlukile zilingana. Akukhona ukuthi izinto eziningi zanele; ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo yikho okubalulekile.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.prompt: Chazela uMina. Bhala (1) lapho isimangalo sokuqala siphosile khona, ngesibonelo senombolo, no-(2) ukuthi umsebenzi onezimo ezifanayo awuhlali ukhona, usebenzisa i-codomain.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.0: Thatha elinye lamathebula owenze esinyathelweni 2 njengoba linjalo, bese ubhala amanani amane nezamba ezimbili.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.1: Khetha i-codomain eyodwa ongayikhethanga esinyathelweni 3, bese ubhala emshweni owodwa ukuthi kungani umsebenzi ungenakwenziwa nge-codomain leyo.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Esibonelweni sakho senombolo, kucacile ukuthi wonke amanani amane ahlukile futhi izamba zamapheya amabili ziyalingana?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Uhlukanise lokho “oyodwa-kwenye” ositshela kona nalokho ongasitsheli?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Unikeze izibonelo (icala elinezinto ezimbalwa kakhulu, noma icala elingenamapheya anezamba ezilinganayo) ezikhombisa ukuthi kuye ngokuthi i-codomain, umsebenzi ungase ube khona noma ungabi khona?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.0: Amanani amane ahlukile angaba nezamba ezilinganayo. Isibonelo, uma u-f(1)=3, f(2)=1, f(3)=6, f(4)=4, khona-ke amanani wonke ahlukile futhi 3+4=1+6=7. Kodwa uma i-codomain isethi efana no-{1, 2, 4, 8, 16}, engenamapheya amabili anezamba ezilinganayo, umsebenzi onjalo ungenakwenziwa.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.1: Umsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye usho kuphela ukuthi amanani awagqagqani; awusho ukuthi izamba ziyahluka. Uma u-f(1)=2, f(2)=1, f(3)=4, f(4)=3, khona-ke 2+3=1+4=5, ngakho izamba ziyalingana. Kodwa uma i-codomain inezinto ezi-3 kuphela, azikho ngisho nomsebenzi oyodwa-kwenye, ngakho kuye ngokuthi i-codomain iyisethi iphi, umsebenzi ungase ube khona noma ungabi khona.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Ayizange isho ukuthi amanani ayakhula yini, kodwa inakho kokubili isibonelo esiphikisayo nesimo se-codomain.
